name: Measurements, Instrumentation & Experimental Methods
summary: Planning experiments and measuring force, strain, pressure, temperature, flow and motion reliably, with proper uncertainty analysis and reporting.

topics.name: Measurement system elements and static characteristics (accuracy, precision, resolution, linearity, hysteresis)
Dynamic response of instruments (first- and second-order sensors)
Statistics for experimentation and uncertainty analysis (propagation, confidence intervals)
Signal conditioning: bridges, amplifiers and filters
Data acquisition: sampling, aliasing, quantisation and ADCs
Spectral analysis and the FFT for measurement data
Strain, force, torque and pressure measurement (strain gauges, load cells, transducers)
Flow measurement (differential pressure, turbine, Coriolis, ultrasonic, hot-wire)
Motion measurement: displacement (LVDT, encoders), velocity and acceleration (accelerometers)
Design of experiments and test planning
Technical reporting and presentation of experimental results
